title: The Adventures of the Abbotts
paragraphs: A husband-and-wife mystery series based on Frances Crane's characters Pat and Jean Abbott, following the detective couple as travel and social engagements repeatedly turn into murder cases.

NBC revival of Frances Crane Pat and Jean Abbott mystery characters, starring Les Damon and Claudia Morgan. Frozen subset contains eight consecutive surviving broadcasts from January 23 through March 27, 1955 with one missing weekly historical slot before episode 20.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: NBC revival (October 3, 1954 to June 12, 1955) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Bernard L. Schubert (producer), Claudia Morgan (performer), Dewey Bergman (composer, conductor, and performer), Frances Crane (creator), Harry Frazee (director and recordist), Howard Merrill (writer), and Les Damon (performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]] and [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

The stories often return to married-couple detective mystery, marriage and partnership, travel and social settings turning into crime scenes, color-title mystery convention, and AFRTS preservation/rebroadcast.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes 1954-55 NBC Adventures of the Abbotts revival and AFRTS circulation of Abbott revival recordings.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|x-minus-one|X Minus One]], [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]], [[show|words-at-war|Words at War]], [[show|theater-five|Theater Five]], and [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]].
